scope: Four focused schedules across original/guarded and watchdog0/1. Exact current callbacks/methods; process, boot, exit fence and durability ports controlled. Not live VDS evidence.

caseDistinctions.channel-exit: Actual current exited callback and requestRecovery while CH2 boot is pending. Original loses new CH1 fault; guard rejects completion.
caseDistinctions.channel-exit-at-jobs: Actual channel exit while independent world enable_jobs ACK is pending. Exercises second guard after await.
caseDistinctions.world-exit: Actual world exited callback during later channel boot. Original startJobs already rejects; negative control preserved by guard.
caseDistinctions.channel-replaced: Controlled healthy same-channel newer-row substitution. Defensive generation check, not proof of reachable concurrent boot.

result.scope: controlled replacement exit while later channels boot; actual frozen/current GlobalWorldCoordinator, SharedCombatBridge, channel/world exited callbacks, channel requestRecovery and world startJobs/health bodies; OS boot/fence/durability ports mocked; newer-row substitution is a defensive identity guard test, not proof of reachable concurrent boot
